Europe doesn't switch until Mar 29, so for the week of Mar 9 offsets will be different than usual. I'm including that to avoid the common off-by-one-hour confusion.

I put together an availability matrix (attached) and two proposed blocks that often work for multi-region execs:
- Option A: Mar 10, 16:00 UTC — 12:00 EDT / 09:00 PDT / 17:00 CET / 01:00 JST (Mar 11) — favors US/EU, late for Tokyo
- Option B: Mar 11, 06:00 UTC — 02:00 EDT / 23:00 PDT (Mar 10) / 07:00 CET / 15:00 JST — favors EU/APAC, early for US West

If both are terrible for Tokyo leadership, we can do a 30–45 min recorded/full demo for APAC and schedule a shorter follow-up for the exec Q&A at a time that suits them.

I've attached availability_matrix.xlsx — please fill it out with your exec times (local times are fine) and I'll convert and pick an agreed slot.
